sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: Source material that supports a statement or answer.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: An answer is easier to trust when you can inspect the paragraph it relied on.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: The exact chunk containing the illustrative Joule Studio sentence is supporting evidence.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Evidence bundles resolve exact chunk IDs with immutable version and source provenance, subject to current access checks.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Evidence lets a reader check an answer instead of trusting fluent text alone.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: A mixed-access evidence bundle fails closed when any requested chunk cannot be returned.

sections.title: Implementation
